$comment: Canonical shape of the application tracker. This file is the single source of truth for both projects: scripts/make-internship-tracker.mjs builds internship-tracker.xlsx from it, and the /rank, /apply, /outcome and /html-report commands read and write data/tracker.csv against it. Change a column or a status here and nowhere else.

columns.note: Row number, filled in by the sheet.
Portal skill name for CLI-sourced rows, e.g. linkedin-search.
Comma-separated gives an exact Fit %; prose assumes at least three.

statuses.meaning: Found it, still reading. Nothing sent.
Decided to apply. Materials not sent yet.
Sent. Set the Sent date on the same edit.
Chased after the two-week wait. Set Followed up.
Invited or interviewed. Set the Interview date.
Offer in hand, not yet accepted.
Taken. GJU: tell OIL, the Project Office and your Exchange Coordinator, then withdraw the rest.
They said no, or the posting closed.

statusNote: This list is the only status vocabulary in the repo. /outcome writes one of these values, /rank groups by them, /html-report and /notion-sync render them, and the workbook validates against them. Anything else is a bug.
